Celine Dion makes emotional comeback concert in Paris

Celine Dion returned to the stage for her first Paris concert in six years, marking a comeback after being sidelined by a rare diagnosis. During the emotional opening night of her Paris residency, Dion delivered a speech stating she has decided to make her health battle "my reason for living." The singer reportedly wowed fans and was declared a "true fighter" as she performed, with some coverage noting she might be better than ever. Her return to Paris has been described as rekindling a sense of national unity in France.
